resolved_finding.issue: Status3 originally promised all output I/O failures although PCM publication errors are returned in a player-failure report/status1
resolved_finding.resolution: C header and Rust docs now specify status1 for any player-run error including input/PCM I/O; status3 only directory/result publication failure; source behavior unchanged

reviewed: Compared lib.rs mechanically with prior main.rs: argument source/report callback extraction only; all parser/simulation/publication and feature-gated paths preserved
Bounded byte/path/tick/viewport admission and deny_unknown_fields; absolute paths cannot inject CLI flags; ordinary package route remains fixed and no module/window override is exposed
C pointer preflight avoids slice construction for null/zero/oversize; unsafe readable immutable caller allocation contract is explicit
Fresh-directory reservation; create-only PCM and synced staged no-clobber result; no multi-file rollback/durability claim
Tests exercise cooked native movement/input/observations/silent PCM/repeat and create-only reuse refusal, malformed requests/checksum refusal, and late guest failure with report/no PCM
Reviewed optional CPU/GPU/window gates and build-linked program selector; no new source compiler, arbitrary loader, per-tick JSON or authoring dependencies
limits: Source-only independent review; no local test/build rerun
Feature compatibility, C/Swift calls, iOS/Android compile and final execution evidence remain root-owned pending checks
No device/frame-time/rendered/audio-device/performance or full mobile host acceptance
C ABI requires valid caller memory; it does not promise recovery from Rust panics or allocation aborts
Player assertion failure may publish completed PCM under unchanged CLI semantics; failure reports distinguish it from a simulation abort
